CARD
**Ready for review**

Comments on pull requests from Gogs, Gitea and Forgejo should now show the right topic and message. Before, they looked like comments on an issue. The author tested this on a Forgejo instance and posted before and after screenshots.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ℹ️  | There were 12 new pushes since the "not ready" label, which came with no written feedback. The PR now has 2 files and 2 commits, including a fix to the Gitea test for PR comments. |
| ✅  | The Gogs view now tells PR comments apart from issue comments. The author fixed the opposite bug (issue comments wrongly shown as PR comments) that they reported on 2026-09-08. |
| ✅  | The description, how it was tested, screenshots and self-review checklist are filled in. CI passed. |
| ⚠️  | The author says the check may not work if the Gogs or Gitea payload format has changed. Gogs has no `is_pull` field, so this check is the only option there. |
| ℹ️  | The same author has an open PR, #40096, on the Gogs integration (topic title for pull requests). It may touch the same code. |

**Reviewer:** @laurynmm — added the "not ready" label, and the author asked them for review. Niloth P has also changed these files recently.

###### Next step

Remove "not ready", add "integration review", and assign @laurynmm.

###### Reply

```quote
@laurynmm, could you review this?
```
